title: Inspire Science: Integrated, Grade 6 (Write-In Student Edition, Units 1-4)
edition: 2020 (copyright 2020 on the publisher page; ISBN records say 2019)

sources.what: publisher scope and sequence (units, modules, lessons)
publisher product page for the same series (confirms copyright and 5E structure)

summary: An NGSS-built integrated middle-school science course sold as four write-in unit books, each organised into modules and 5E lessons. Grade 6 covers cells and body systems, reproduction and heredity, thermal energy with weather and climate, and human impact on Earth's systems.

toc.label: Unit 1
toc.title: Life: Structure & Function
toc.covers: How living things are built from cells and how cells form tissues, organs, and organ systems that keep the body running.

children.label: Module
children.title: Cells and Life
children.covers: Characteristics of living things, cell theory, and the parts and jobs of cells.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Exploring Life
children.covers: Traits all living things share, unicellular vs multicellular organisms, and how microscopes revealed cells.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Cell Structure and Function
children.covers: Organelles such as the nucleus, membrane, mitochondria and chloroplasts, and plant vs animal cells.

children.label: Module
children.title: Body Systems
children.covers: How organ systems interact to support, fuel, transport, and control the body.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Levels of Organization
children.covers: The hierarchy from cells to tissues, organs, organ systems, and organisms.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Structure and Support
children.covers: Skeletal and muscular systems and the support structures of plants.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Obtaining Energy and Removing Waste
children.covers: Digestive, respiratory, and excretory systems and how organisms take in nutrients and remove wastes.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Moving Materials
children.covers: The circulatory system and plant vascular tissue that move water, nutrients, and gases.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Control and Information Processing
children.covers: The nervous system and sense receptors that detect stimuli and send signals to the brain.

toc.label: Unit 2
toc.title: Reproduction of Organisms
toc.covers: How organisms pass on traits and how reproduction and growth work in animals and plants.

children.label: Module
children.title: Reproduction of Organisms
children.covers: Heredity, sexual vs asexual reproduction, and factors that affect growth.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Inheritance
children.covers: Genes, alleles, dominant and recessive traits, Punnett squares, and mutations.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Types of Reproduction
children.covers: Asexual vs sexual reproduction and the genetic variation each produces.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Reproduction and Growth of Animals
children.covers: Animal behaviours such as courtship and parental care, and genetic and environmental effects on growth.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Reproduction and Growth of Plants
children.covers: Flower structures, pollination, seed dispersal, and conditions that affect plant growth.

toc.label: Unit 3
toc.title: Energy in the Atmosphere
toc.covers: Particle motion and thermal energy transfer, then how the sun's energy drives the water cycle, weather, and climate.

children.label: Module
children.title: Energy and Matter
children.covers: The particle model of matter and how thermal energy moves.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Particles in Motion
children.covers: Kinetic molecular model, temperature, and thermal energy.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: States of Matter
children.covers: Solids, liquids, gases, and changes of state as energy is added or removed.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Thermal Energy Transfers
children.covers: Conduction, convection, and radiation.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Thermal Energy Conductivity
children.covers: Conductors and insulators and designing devices that slow or speed heat transfer.

children.label: Module
children.title: The Water Cycle
children.covers: How sunlight and gravity move water through the atmosphere and across Earth's surface.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Water in the Atmosphere
children.covers: Evaporation, condensation, humidity, clouds, and precipitation.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Water on Earth's Surface
children.covers: Runoff, groundwater, glaciers, and oceans, and where Earth's water is stored.

children.label: Module
children.title: Weather and Climate
children.covers: Uneven solar heating, circulation of air and ocean, weather systems, and climate zones.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Solar Energy on Earth
children.covers: Why the sun heats Earth unevenly by latitude and how the atmosphere absorbs and reflects energy.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Atmospheric and Oceanic Circulation
children.covers: Global wind belts, the Coriolis effect, and ocean currents that move heat.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Weather Patterns
children.covers: Air masses, fronts, pressure systems, and forecasting.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Climates of Earth
children.covers: Factors that set climate and Earth's major climate zones.

toc.label: Unit 4
toc.title: Human Impact on the Environment
toc.covers: How human activity changes land, water, air, and climate, and ways to reduce those effects.

children.label: Module
children.title: Human Impact on the Environment
children.covers: Human effects on Earth's systems and designing solutions to limit them.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Impact on Land
children.covers: Deforestation, urban growth, mining, farming, and land conservation.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Impact on Water
children.covers: Water pollution, runoff, overuse, and protecting water supplies.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Impact on the Atmosphere
children.covers: Air pollution, smog, acid rain, and ozone depletion.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Impact on Climate
children.covers: Greenhouse gases, rising global temperatures, and ways to reduce emissions.

notes: Headings are from the publisher's scope and sequence, which lists units, modules, and lessons without numbers; module and lesson numbering in the printed book is not shown there. Modules are nested under units and lessons under modules (a third level of children). Unit 1 is ISBN 9780076873302 and Unit 2 is 9780076873333; the school list holds only those two ISBNs, so check whether Units 3-4 are on hand.
